🚀 Two new features are live on SDAS.space!
Check out the screenshot for a look at our newest additions:
🛠️ Pilot’s Toolkit
Six handy community resources in one place:
• UEX: Trading and market data
• Erkul: Ship loadouts
• SC Craft Tools: Crafting and blueprints
• SC Trade Tools: Trade routes and commodities
• Star Citizen Wiki: Guides and reference
• StarStrings: Community-made text improvements
Swipe through the cards or use the arrows, then click a tool to open its website in a new tab.
📡 SDAS News Wire
Catch up on org announcements without digging through Discord. The news carousel automatically pulls from #org-news, includes artwork when available, and shows the newest posts first.

items.title: ***A Message About Our Org***
items.body:
It's come to my attention that some members may have concerns that SDAS has become more of a pirate organization lately. I want to take a moment to clear a few things up and explain where we stand as an Org.
**First and foremost, SDAS is NOT a pirate Org.**
SDAS was founded on a simple idea: to create a community where anyone can come together, meet cool people, make friends, and have fun playing Star Citizen. That means **ALL game loops**, whether it's mining, salvaging, cargo hauling, PvE, PvP, exploration, or yes, even piracy.
Piracy does happen within SDAS. I'm not going to pretend it doesn't. However, it happens far less frequently than some people might think. And when it does happen,

items.title: **I will not build or restrict SDAS around one singular playstyle, regardless of how strongly some people may feel about
items.body:
I also want to say this: if you're avoiding joining Org nights or hanging out with members simply because you've heard that some people participate in piracy, you're missing out on a genuinely awesome group of people.
SDAS has some of the most helpful, generous, and downright hilarious individuals I've ever met in the verse. I've seen people go out of their way to help other members with absolutely nothing to gain for themselves, simply because that's what we do here.
And I don't want anyone overlooking that side of this community.

items.title: 🚀 SDAS FLEET MANAGER IS HERE!
items.body:
Some Dudes and a Fleet Manager is ready for the org!
Good Friends. Bad Ideas. Legendary Stories.
Ever wondered who in SDAS owns that ship you need for an operation? Or who has a MOLE, a C2, a medical ship, or something with enough firepower to make questionable decisions even more questionable?
Well, now there’s a place to find out!
We’ve built our own online Fleet Manager, designed specifically for Some Dudes and a Spaceship.
🛸 What can you do?
* My Hangar: Add and manage your personal Star Citizen fleet, including pledged and aUEC ships.
* Org Fleet Registry: Browse ships that SDAS members have chosen to share with the org.
* Pilot Directory: Find members and see their shared vessels.
